title: Replace an unregistered vehicle permit (UVP)
summary: You can apply for a replacement unregistered vehicle permit (UVP) if your current permit is lost, destroyed, or stolen.
intro:
If you hold an unregistered vehicle permit (UVP) and your permit is lost, destroyed or stolen, but is still current, you can apply for a new one at a Service NSW Centre.

A replacement fee will be charged.
who_can_apply: You must hold an unregistered vehicle permit (UVP) that is still current.
The permit must be lost, destroyed, or stolen.

how_to_steps.text: Make sure you have the required documentation.
Visit a service centre and provide the information in person.

external_links.text: Application for Unregistered Vehicle Permit – PDF
Form 1018: Replacement Application – Transport for NSW – PDF

internal_links.text: Apply for an unregistered vehicle permit

faqs.q: What do I need to replace my UVP?
faqs.a: You need your proof of identity and the 'Replacement Application' PDF form.

faqs.q: Where do I submit my replacement application?
faqs.a: You must visit a Service NSW Centre to provide the information in person.

faqs.q: Is there a fee for replacing the permit?
faqs.a: Yes, a replacement fee will be charged.
